nodes.label: Backend Module Layout (index/model/services)
nodes.rationale: Same feature name across index/, model/, services/ keeps routes, validation and business logic discoverable and separated.

nodes.label: One Exported Function Per Service File
nodes.rationale: Reusable operations get their own file; private helpers may stay with the function.

nodes.label: 200-Line Source File Limit
nodes.rationale: Readability: oversized files must be split into focused files following module conventions.

nodes.label: Plain User-Facing Words Rule
nodes.rationale: Five-year-old-level wording (Add More, Take Away, Change Amount, Change History) in mobile labels, buttons, messages and docs; synthetic content labelled Sample data.

nodes.label: Manual Endpoint Testing Policy
nodes.rationale: Owner tests endpoints manually in Elysia OpenAPI or Postman; no automated endpoint tests unless requested.

nodes.label: Configuration and Secrets Policy
nodes.rationale: Secrets live only in server-side .env; client builds can expose mobile/web env files.

nodes.label: Comprehensive UI/UX Standards and Laws
nodes.source_location: Comprehensive UI/UX Standards, Laws & Psychological Theories
nodes.rationale: All web and mobile interfaces must cite the relevant law and its author when proposing UI/UX decisions.

nodes.label: Fitts's Law (Paul Fitts)
nodes.rationale: Primary CTAs at least 48px high, icon-only buttons at least 44x44px, destructive controls separated from confirmations.

nodes.label: Forest Green / Warm Cream Figure-Ground Palette
nodes.rationale: Primary buttons Forest Green #1F4D3A; white cards #FFFFFF with 1px #E5E2DA borders over Warm Cream #F8F6F1.

nodes.label: Where AGENTS.md Is Stale
nodes.rationale: AGENTS.md says web/ and analytics/ hold no code and lists only partial modules; web is Next.js 15, mobile is a full Expo app, more backend modules exist.

nodes.label: Monorepo Layout (backend, web, mobile, n8n, deploy)
Two Processes: API and Scheduled Worker
nodes.rationale: index.ts serves HTTP and also runs a 30s interval; worker.ts runs jobs every 60s; shared jobs must be idempotent and exactly one worker may run.

nodes.label: Auth and Roles (Better Auth sessionAuth macro)
Shared Domain Utils (ranking, trust, s3, email, push)
visibility-ahptopsis-v1 Promotion Policy
nodes.rationale: Priority Boost requires TOPSIS closeness >= 0.60.

nodes.label: Trust Points and Trust Actions
nodes.rationale: Weighted points for non-response, cancellation and low ratings; actions gated by TRUST_ACTIONS_ENABLED.

nodes.label: Database Schema and Drizzle Migrations
nodes.rationale: App never applies migrations itself; migrations are an explicit release step.

nodes.label: n8n Promotion and Social Publishing Integration
nodes.rationale: Worker sends n8n only IDs; n8n calls back to /integrations/* with a Bearer service token to fetch current context.

nodes.label: Tracked backend/dist Gotcha
nodes.rationale: dist/index.js and dist/worker.js are tracked and run by Docker Compose; stale dist affects deploys.

nodes.label: Backend Plugins (security headers, rate limit, validation, CORS)

Mobile 5-Item Bottom Dock with Center FAB
Seller Home Dashboard (twin actions, 2x2 metrics, 3x2 hub)
Change Amount Stock Adjustment Flow
nodes.rationale: Uses plain words Add More, Take Away and Change History instead of stock in/out.

nodes.label: AHP-TOPSIS Visibility Breakdown Card
nodes.rationale: Shows placement score, tier badge and factor weights Freshness 40%, Stock 30%, Reliability 20%, Recurrence 10%.

nodes.label: Mobile Color Semantics and Design Tokens
Mobile Accessibility Standards
nodes.rationale: Status never conveyed by color alone; 44x44 minimum touch targets; 4.5:1 contrast.

nodes.label: Plain Words Mapping Table (Stock In -> Add More)
Marketplace Reference Layout (filter rail + product grid)
nodes.rationale: Screenshot supplied 2026-09-24 is a hierarchy and spacing aid only; Agrivive keeps its own palette, type, produce content, Buy Now flow and multi-store cart.

nodes.label: Authentication Pages Layout (form + market image panel)
Buyer Orders Page and Order Detail
Web Color Tokens (Forest Green, Warm Cream)
Marketplace Product Card and Detail Patterns
Cart and Multi-Store Checkout
nodes.rationale: Checkout creates one seller order per store; each seller scans only that store's QR; backend stock and prices are authoritative; payment stays direct at pickup.

nodes.label: 90 UX Laws Application Checklist
nodes.rationale: Used as a design-review checklist rather than forcing every law onto every screen.

nodes.label: Existing System Is the Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: Screenshots define layout, colors, typography, spacing and styling only; never fields, data, functionality or schema.

nodes.label: Default Architecture (Next.js, Tailwind v4, Motion, Phosphor icons)
Color Calibration and Premium-Consumer Palette Ban
Layout Discipline Hard Rules (hero, eyebrow, zigzag)
Eyebrow Restraint Rule
nodes.rationale: Maximum one eyebrow per three sections; every AI-built site puts one above every header, producing templated rhythm.

nodes.label: GSAP Sticky-Stack and Horizontal-Pan Skeletons
nodes.rationale: start must be 'top top' with pin true or the trigger fires halfway through scroll.

nodes.label: Em-Dash Ban
nodes.rationale: The em-dash is the number one visual LLM tell; only the regular hyphen is permitted.

nodes.label: Apple Liquid Glass Web Approximation
nodes.rationale: No official liquid-glass CSS exists; the web version is a labeled glassmorphism approximation.

nodes.label: Recommended Feature-Based Project Structure
nodes.rationale: Controller (index.ts), service, model per feature when no preference is given.
